docs_read.note: Endpoint reference: create enqueues the initial run, run statuses, one active run per agent, terminal cancellation with 409 run_not_cancellable, per-agent git snapshot, agent-scoped artifacts, public beta
API overview: basic-or-bearer authentication with a user or service-account API key, standard rate limiting without figures, Cloud Agents beta on all plans

Security and networking statements: isolated-VMs claim, default internet egress, encrypted secrets and snapshots; conversation history indefinite by default, optional Enterprise 90-day retention, and rolling 90-day snapshot inactivity retention (mutable prose, not guaranteed API replay)

schema_receipt.scope: Anonymous official public schema read only; no live API/account call
schema_receipt.conversion: yaml2.9.1 safe parse -> JSON; exact selected paths/methods with transitive local components; no schema behavior altered
schema_receipt.pinMeaning: Read-time official schema snapshot fingerprint, not a stable vendor build or verified native behavior
schema_receipt.derivationNote: Four UTF-8 em dash description repairs against retained OFFICIAL_OPENAPI.json; fields, selected methods and local refs unchanged. Original preparation subset checksum retained separately.

normalization: POST /v1/agents is the single selected native start: the pinned description says it immediately enqueues the initial run, so resource creation is run creation; submit maps to exactly one create per task lifetime and follow-up POST /runs is never used for the same task.

Run state normalization: CREATING to queued, RUNNING to running, FINISHED to succeeded, ERROR to failed with TASK_FAILED, CANCELLED to cancelled; EXPIRED to failed with TASK_LIMIT is a candidate mapping whose native semantics are undefined in the reviewed inputs.

Result text is normalized from the observed terminal Run.result of the exact retained run; sequences, result digests and artifact descriptors are adapter-owned, and native per-agent artifact metadata without digests is not mapped into digest-bound descriptors.

Cancellation is cooperative: a 200 IdResponse receipt yields cancel_requested until a bounded GET observes CANCELLED; a 409 run_not_cancellable triggers observation because completion may have won; archive/delete is never used as cancellation.

Repository binding sends repos[0].startingRef as the exact approved commit SHA with workOnCurrentBranch false; Run.git branch and PR references are proposed output metadata, never evidence, adoption or download permission.

Authentication is a Cursor account API key (Basic username or Bearer); it is separate from the host ExecutionGrant service/instance/source/repository binding and never appears in DTOs or persisted errors.

The only documented duplicate prevention is 409 agent_id_conflict on a re-POSTed client agentId; it is not an idempotent reply and supplies no run-level dedup, so journal reservation and uncertain-admission rules carry recovery.

The mechanically selected official schema text and receipt are embedded in pinned.schema_subset_json/schema_receipt for portable offline validation; reference/ paths in provenance name the preparation inputs only and are not runtime dependencies.

Known-agent latestRunId reconciliation is conditional on the explicit synthetic recovery_assumptions: a dedicated, exclusively controlled agent, no foreign follow-up runs, and initial-run attribution. These assumptions are not native evidence; absent actual proof, the admission remains uncertain.
